questions.question: The local government has decided to increase the fare of public buses by 15% starting next month. Which of the following can be definitely inferred from the statement?

options.text: The quality of public bus service will improve.
options.explanation: This is a possible reason or assumption behind the decision, not a definite inference.

options.text: The government is facing a financial deficit.
options.explanation: This is a possible reason or assumption behind the decision, not a definite inference.

options.text: The government expects to collect more money from bus fares.
options.explanation: This is the most direct and definite logical consequence of increasing fares.

options.text: People will shift to other modes of transport.
options.explanation: This is a possible future outcome, but not a definite inference from the act of increasing fares.

questions.explanation: If the government increases fares, the most direct and definite logical consequence, assuming people continue to use the service, is that they expect to generate more revenue.
